Home

Say-Mean-Matter Discussion

Badge

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This badge recognizes your active participation in the course’s learning community. By engaging in meaningful discussions, sharing insights, and responding thoughtfully to peers, you’ve contributed to a rich and collaborative learning experience. Your contributions help build a supportive environment where ideas can flourish, and together, we grow as educators.

Criteria

  • Respond to a quote or excerpt using the Say-Mean-Matter Framework.

  • Share your response and reflect on the experience in the Say-Mean-Matter discussion.

  • Respond to at least two other participants’ posts to engage in conversation and exchange ideas.
